3682-5660-6769-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3682-5660-6769-6797.description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding one mana of any color among legendary creatures and planeswalkers you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Mox Amber, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Mox Amber from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

5035-5104-6495.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-6495.notes:
It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

7687-7690-7736.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
7687-7690-7736.description:
Draw a card.
Shang-Chi and the Ten Rings triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token with defender.
When the Wall enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2021-2060-3062-6774.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

880-3875-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Tireless Provisioner and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-7452.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cauldron of Essence trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

186-1409-4549.easyPrerequisites: You control a nontoken legendary creature that is paired with Deadeye Navigator.
186-1409-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping the legendary creature that's paired with Deadeye Navigator, adding {U}.
Activate the legendary creature by paying {U} due to Heartstone, blinking it.
When the legendary creature enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing the legendary creature and Deadeye Navigator.
Repeat.

1558-1671-3875-4231-4321.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-1671-3875-4231-4321.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Peregrin Took.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

372-5913-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Personify exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5913-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Personify.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

273-2034-3169-7070.description:
Activate Shuko by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the creature.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {2}.
When the creature enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

575-6798-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-6798-7084.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2416-2557-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-3095-6871.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters, Overburden triggers, causing you to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph.
Repeat.

539-2292-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-1482-1849.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-5412.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5412.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5412.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

301-1099-2595.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it.
Activate Sling-Gang Lieutenant by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Sling-Gang Lieutenant ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2835-3490-4659-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2835-3490-4659-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

338-3188-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-3188-3197.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

397-5670-5870.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
397-5670-5870.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Stimulus Package by sacrificing the Treasure, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token.
When the Citizen enters the battlefield, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and get {E}.
Repeat.

1274-2034-3490-4268.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-2034-3490-4268.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

4772-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
4772-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
4772-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking
Repeat from step 3.

2178-3143-3197.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Herd Baloth has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
2178-3143-3197.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Xavier Sal triggers, untapping Xavier Sal.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth, you may instead use Xavier Sal's first ability to get infinite copies of creature tokens you control.

985-5060-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
985-5060-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

527-979-5137.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 9 or greater.
527-979-5137.description:
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Selvala.
Activate Likeness Looter using Selvala's ability by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {7}{G}{U}.
Activate Likeness Looter by paying {3}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling.
Activate Likeness Looter using Morphling's first ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

413-678-4033.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is greater than your maximum hand size.
413-678-4033.description:
Move to your cleanup step.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard Basking Rootwalla.
Basking Rootwalla is discarded into exile, triggering its madness ability, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
When Basking Rootwalla enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Basking Rootwalla.
When Basking Rootwalla dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Basking Rootwalla from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Once the stack is empty and all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs.
Repeat from step 2.

4591-5016-5109.description:
Cast Volcano Hellion by paying {2}{R}{R}.
Volcano Hellion enters the battlefield, dealing an arbitrarily large amount of damage to Spitemare and you.
You do not lose the game due to having zero or less life due to Platinum Angel.
Spitemare triggers, dealing an arbitarily large amount of damage to target opponent.

396-1409-3000-4050.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with another creature.
396-1409-3000-4050.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability and Blessed Sanctuary triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and another creature you control.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorn and Squirrel, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3121-4499-4659.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Marionette Master.
When Marionette Master enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, creating three 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Servos, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the tokens die, Marionette Master triggers twice, causing target opponent to lose life equal to twice Marionette Master's power.
Repeat.

2011-2060-2090.notablePrerequisites:
Crystalline Crawler has at least six +1/+1 counters on it.
Bright-Palm and Najeela do not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2011-2060-2090.description:
Declare Bright-Palm and Najeela as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Bright-Palm trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
 Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1247-3918-5116.description:
Activate Trazyn using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

283-3996-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Twilight Drover.
Twilight Drover has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
283-3996-4050.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it.
Illusionists's Bracers triggers, copying Twilight Drover's ability.
Resolve both Twilight Drover abilities, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1486-3297-4644.notablePrerequisites: Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
1486-3297-4644.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution targeting Magda, changing all instances of "Dwarf" to either "Elemental" or "Minion".
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping itself, targeting itself.
Magda triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Tidewater Minion's ability, untapping itself.
Repeat from step 2.

985-2146-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat
